title: NIP Processed Transcript Import
description: One external-agent analysis tied to an existing retained NIP event. Every evidence_quote must occur exactly once in that event's transcript. This is the payload for build_agent_narrative_graph; producer/model provenance is caller-declared and unattested.

event_id.description: Exact event_id supplied with the copied retained transcript. Import rejects any event without retained transcript text.

producer.description: Caller-declared producer, such as the external agent or tool. It is not verified by NIP.

model.description: Caller-declared model or processing method; not cryptographically attested.

prompt_version.description: Prompt/skill revision used to produce the analysis.

narrative_title.description: Short title for the transcript-level narrative.

narrative_thesis.description: Concise, evidence-grounded thesis; distinguish source statements from interpretation.

narrative_summary.description: Short summary grounded only in this transcript.

entities.description: Event-scoped entity candidates. NIP keeps these unresolved; do not invent canonical security/ticker mappings.

surface_form.description: Exact name as it appears within evidence_quote.

evidence_quote.description: Exact, unique transcript quote containing surface_form.

claims.description: Claims must be explicitly supported by the transcript, and each entity_names entry must match an entities.canonical_name.

speaker_or_author.description: Speaker/author only when clear from the transcript; otherwise null or omit.

confidence_millis.description: Confidence on a 0–1000 scale, not a probability guarantee.

evidence_quote.description: Exact quote that occurs exactly once in the retained transcript.

horizon.description: Time horizon only when the transcript states or clearly implies one; otherwise null or omit.
